select distinct A.FINPROD_ID id, B.FINPROD_ABBR text, A.FINPROD_TYPE2 object from SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID
and ( FINPROD_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') )

select distinct A.APPLY_TRADE_ID id, A.APPLY_TRADE_ID text from SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL A INNER JOIN SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL_STATUS B ON A.SEQ_ID = B.SEQ_NO
1=1 AND (B.MATCH_STATUS IN (#{TRD_MATCH_STATUS_01},#{TRD_MATCH_STATUS_02}) OR B.MATCH_STATUS IS NULL)
and A.APPLY_TRADE_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%')
